title: Over 30% of the English-language web is written by AI, according to Pew - TCR 08/21/26
description:
Pew analyzed nearly 500,000 English-language webpages and found more than a third of those published since ChatGPT show significant signs of AI authorship, AIntibody's blinded 511-antibody benchmark from 29 organizations reached 95 picomolar on affinity work while failing to generalize, and LG opened North America's largest battery-cell plant in Michigan at 35+ GWh a year.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-21-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:48 Pew maps the AI-written web
6:43 AIntibody blinded benchmark and the validation gap
9:53 NSF grants fall as $1 billion goes central
12:34 Sodium-ion gain and LG's Michigan battery plant
15:18 The first full-length AI-generated feature
17:38 Close

This episode covers the Pew AI-authorship study, the AIntibody blinded competition and the antibody validation gap, the NSF issuing its fewest grants in four decades as $1 billion is held for a White House AI project, Geely's 500 Wh/kg solid-state claim against a verified 206 Wh/kg sodium-ion cathode and LG's Michigan plant, and Higgsfield AI's $2 million fully AI-generated feature film.

The headlining signal is a number Pew put on the machine-written web: run through an AI-detection analysis, more than a third of English-language pages published since late 2022 carry significant signs of AI authorship, and the share climbs across the publication months measured. The generative response is arriving on the same cycle - provenance signing, disclosure standards, and Pew's own classifier, built to read who or what made a page. Against that, AIntibody gave antibody design a prospective, blinded report card meant to be harder to game: 511 designs, 29 organizations, every designer blinded, real work on affinity maturation up to 95 picomolar and honest failure to generalize on the harder tasks. The NSF is on course for its fewest grants since the early 1980s as a billion dollars is steered toward a central AI agenda, even as open-weight models and shared compute diffuse the ability to ask questions. On energy, a peer-reviewed sodium-ion cathode hit 99% oxygen-redox reversibility while LG's Michigan cell plant opened to bipartisan applause. And Higgsfield shipped a 110-minute feature in four weeks for $2 million, half of it compute, as director James Gray called the push obscene. The thread: the floor cost of making things is collapsing, and the instruments to verify what floods in are landing in the same cycle.
